title: Compatible local module tuples satisfy the sheaf condition
statement: For any gluing datum G and its module presheaf of all-test-object compatible tuples [def-weil-pbc-site-module-compatible-tuples], the underlying additive presheaf is a sheaf for K.

source.place: Tag 04TR, Lemma sites-lemma-glue-sheaves; compatible-tuples construction, with componentwise module operations.

proof.text: For a covering sieve S on V and each span W → V, W → U_i, pull S back to W and then to the slice over U_i. Evaluate the matching tuple family on this slice, obtaining a compatible family in the local sheaf F_i. Its sheaf axiom gives a unique glued coordinate.

Use separatedness of the appropriate local sheaf on the pulled-back covering sieve to show that these glued coordinates commute with every restriction and every transition equivalence. They therefore form a tuple.

On an arrow in S, validity of the local amalgamations and the matching-family equations identify the restriction of the glued tuple with the given member. Uniqueness follows coordinatewise by local separatedness. Transfer the resulting type-valued sheaf condition to abelian groups using the limit-reflecting forgetful functor.

The parent SiteModuleSheafGluing applies this auxiliary. Mathlib has type-valued sheaf gluing and abstract descent-data APIs, but no instantiated gluing of module sheaves on localizations. Presieve.IsSheafFor.amalgamate and local separatedness suffice for the coordinate construction.
